task.description:
REWORK 1:
- [MAJOR] TC-ADP-04a-06 is not explicitly covered by an automated test. The current suite validates OIDC linkage, idempotent provisioning, and tenant-collision behavior, but it does not exercise multiple internal NULL-linkage rows coexisting alongside duplicate non-NULL realm/sub rejection or schema metadata inspection for the unique external-identity index.

Update the ADP-04a test design so TC-ADP-04a-06 is explicitly represented as an automated case. Add or refine cases to cover: 1) multiple internal users with NULL external linkage coexisting without conflict; 2) duplicate non-NULL (external_realm, external_id) rejection; 3) schema/index metadata verification if needed to prove the unique constraint shape; and 4) a legacy migration fixture if that is the best way to prove backfill behavior. Keep the scope to test design/spec artifacts only; do not touch implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: TC-ADP-04a-06 is explicitly represented in the test spec and mapped to automated coverage
The revised design covers both duplicate non-NULL identity rejection and multiple NULL linkage coexistence
Any migration/backfill fixture needed to prove compatibility is described

result.summary: Reworked the ADP-04a test spec so TC-ADP-04a-06 is explicitly represented as automated integration coverage for NULL-linkage coexistence, duplicate non-NULL realm/sub rejection, and unique index/backfill proof.
